item.title: What you need
item.description:
The rebuild entry point is a Dagger module in this repository. Everything it runs, it runs in containers it puts together, so the machine that calls it needs only two things.

The Dagger CLI

The CLI has to be the version the module pins. That’s v1.0.0-beta.15, the engineVersion in the repository’s dagger-module.toml. Install it with Dagger’s install script, at that version:

curl -fsSL https://dl.dagger.io/dagger/install.sh \
 | DAGGER_VERSION=1.0.0-beta.15 BIN_DIR="$HOME/.local/bin" sh

Check that the CLI on your PATH is the right one:

item.title: Routine maintenance
item.description:
Keeping Dagger current

The rebuild entry point is a Dagger module, and these pin the Dagger it runs on:

  • engineVersion, in every dagger-module.toml: the repository root’s, for the module, and rebuild/tests/dagger-module.toml, for its tests. It pins the engine.
  • DAGGER_VERSION, in .github/workflows/build.yaml: the CLI that Build installs. What you need tells the operator to install the same version.
  • dagger.lock: every image and git ref the workspace uses, by digest or commit. That includes the Go SDK that writes the module’s generated code, and devex’s modules, which the module’s checks run.

Nothing moves any of them except a pull request.

Components

Router

Ubiquiti Dream Machine Pro

Switch

Ubiquiti 48 port PoE

Servers

hp-dl360 - HP ProLiant DL360 Gen 9

  • CPU: 2 x Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2620 v3
  • Mem: 8 x 16GB DDR4-2133 RDIMM
  • Boot: 1 x 250GB Samsung 970 Evo Plus M.2-2280 PCIe 3.0 NVME

  • Power: 2 x HP 500W Flex Slot Platinum Power Supply

camd-ryzen5 - Custom PC

  • CPU: 1 x Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Mem: 2 x 8GB DDR4-3600 CL19
  • Boot: N/A
  • Storage: 1 x 1TB Samsung 970 Evo Plus M.2-2280 PCIe 3.0 NVME

IPMI VLAN

This VLAN groups the IPMI or IPMI-like interfaces for all servers in the homelab so that each machine can be remotely accessed. Most importantly, this access can be restricted via VLAN firewall rules.
